{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Ominous Forge
| Image = Event-OminousForge.png
}} {{Small Relic Infobox|Warped Tongs}} {{Small Card Infobox|Pain}}
{{E|Ominous Forge}} is a shrine [[Event]] encountered in all [[Acts]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Forge}} {{TS|positive||Upgrade a card in your deck.}}
<br><br>
{{Frame|Rummage}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a special relic.}} {{TS|negative||Become Cursed -}} {{C|Pain}}.
* {{R|Warped Tongs}} - At the start of your turn, {{KW|Upgrade}} a random card in your hand for the rest of combat.
* {{C|Pain}} - {{KW|Unplayable}}. While in hand, lose 1 HP whenever you play another card.
<br>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You duck inside a small hut. Inside you find what appears to be a forge. The smithing tools are covered with dust, yet a fire roars inside the furnace. You feel on edge...
</div>

{{Frame|Forge}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You decide to put the forge to use and... <br>
{{TS|gold|shake|CLANG CLAAANG CLANG!}} <br>
...improve your arsenal!
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Rummage}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You decide to see if you can find anything of use. After uncovering tarps, looking through boxes, and checking nooks and crannies, you find a dust covered {{TS|gold|up|relic!}} <br>

Taking the relic, you can't shake a sudden feeling of {{TS|negative|up|sharp pain}} as you exit the hut. Maybe you disturbed some sort of spirit?
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
There doesn't seem to be anything of use. You exit the way you came, the flames of the furnace casting {{TS|purple|up|eerie shadows}} on the walls inside the hut...
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* Internally called Accursed_Blacksmith.
